They then laid the king on a couch set with gems and Bhatata, 
overwhelmed with grief, began to lament. He said : " 0 
Great King. I know not why, in mine absence, thou didst send 
Rama to the forest. Whithet art thou gone, leaving me bereft

banished. 0 Mighty Ruler, this earth is widowed and divested 
of all beauty without thee I Without thee, the capital resembles 
a moonless night." 
Shri Vasishtha again addressed Shri Bhatata, perceiving him

In the sacrificial hall, the priests performed the fire ritual.

brief.summary_1line: Vasishtha urges Bharata to overcome grief and perform King Dasharatha’s funeral rites, culminating in the cremation on the Sarayu’s banks amid royal mourning.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata mourns beside the gem-studded couch where the oil-preserved body of King Dasharatha lies appearing as if asleep.
Servitors carry Dasharatha’s bier through the palace while scattering gold coins and silver flowers and burning incense.
On the banks of the Sarayu, priests chant Vedic hymns as the queens weep and circle the blazing sandalwood pyre of the king.
